decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer sits close to the core offer of a growing firm whose performance meets its aspirations, so there is no problemistic search to trigger a drop, and slack allows the young product time to mature.

The numbering software module is a low-cost extension of the existing printer and software portfolio and supports the firm's digitalization and serialization strategy, so keeping it requires few resources and fits its aspirations.

The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces builds on the firm's ink and coding expertise and widens its customer applications, and with no performance shortfall the satisficing response is to keep it.
